    st=s.state();print('LAPTOP PICK',r['stage_success'],r['failure'],'joint',st['entities']['laptop']['joint_positions'],'tcp',st['robot']['tcp_position'])

        Rroot=Rotation.from_quat([rq[1],rq[2],rq[3],rq[0]])

        site_local=screen_pos+Rscreen.apply([0.,.3,-.16])
        anchor=root+Rroot.apply(hinge_local)
        axis=Rroot.apply(Rscreen.apply([-1.,0.,0.])); axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
        initial_site=root+Rroot.apply(site_local)
        observed=np.array(ent['get_grasped_keypoints'][0],float)
        print('HINGE GEOM',anchor,axis,'site predicted/observed',initial_site,observed)
        # Use the observed site as the trajectory start, retaining the authored hinge axis/anchor.
